description: Any session with a derived identity atomically sets standing enablement rules and matching catalog flags. selector dimensions provider, runtime, model_family_prefix, exact model and effort combine with AND; absent dimensions are wildcards. A rule sets enabled, weight or both; each is optional but at least one is required, and an omitted or null one means the rule has no opinion on it. enabled is a strict boolean. weight is a positive finite number, the operator's preference for the matching cells: select_dispatch_tier multiplies a cell's cost by it when choosing, under every billing objective (below 1 favors the cell, above 1 disfavors it, absent is 1.0), so a preference changes in this one call with no landing. A weight only orders the choice: it never turns a disabled cell on (disabled is off and nothing is a last resort) and it never changes a reported cost, ladder or frontier; the selection reports the applied weight and rule id as advisory data. enabled and weight resolve independently, the last matching rule that carries each one winning. only=true with enabled=true replaces the whole policy, weight rules included, with default-off and matching-on in one transaction. Normal set appends a rule, correct replaces rule_id with exactly what is supplied (so a correction that omits weight clears it), retire or clear with rule_id removes that rule and any weight with it, and clear without rule_id restores explicit default-on and weight 1.0. Read policy first and supply its updated_at as expected_updated_at; explicit null creates the uninitialized policy. A nonempty reason is required. A rule may also name one kind of work with kind, one nonempty word with no whitespace, matched exactly by select_model_cell_for_kind; an absent kind means the rule applies to every request. words keeps the user's words on the rule and defaults to reason. ends_at, an offset-bearing ISO timestamp, ends the rule: at that instant it has no opinion and reads as lapsed (the end is exclusive). Only rules without a kind decide the stored cell flags that select_dispatch_tier reads; a kinded rule changes only what select_model_cell_for_kind grants for that kind. Correct replaces kind and ends_at with exactly what is supplied, so omitting them clears them, and words defaults to reason. Holding Operator is not required: the server derives the calling session and records it with the reason in the immutable history, which is advisory data about who changed what, not an authority check. Zero current matches is advisory and retains the rule for future models. Existing catalog writers preserve flags and new cells evaluate standing rules. Policy, flags and full immutable snapshots in existing refresh/observation audit tables commit or roll back together. No allowance telemetry participates. Readback returns each rule with its weight and every cell's preference_weight with preference_provenance (a rule id or default_weight). Registered calls return a persisted {job_id, status: queued} admission before the complete operation runs on the messaging owner worker. Read job_service.get_job by that exact job_id until terminal; job.result contains the complete original response envelope, and failures also retain job.error. The receipt reports admission; the operation outcome, full history and readback are in that exact job. Direct Python and direct HTTP callers retain their synchronous operation and response. Do not replay effects after an uncertain terminal write or a lost receipt; reconcile the owned job and actual outcome.
embedding_description: Control which AI model and reasoning effort combinations may receive work by enabling or disabling individual models or groups, selecting only a matching family, and setting a preference weight that makes a model more or less favored when work is assigned, then correcting or clearing durable operator choices with atomic changes and retained history.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Current rules (with weights, kind, words, ends_at and lapsed) and updated_at, visible cells with enabled and preference weight provenance, bounded append-only policy history, allocated rule_id and run_id; warnings for uninitialized or zero-match cases and for an only=true call that replaced weight rules.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Show the current policy decisions and provenance clearly. Preserve full immutable history in evidence; explain advisories without blocking progress. Treat a queued job id as admission only. Retrieve the terminal job before presenting the original operation outcome.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Use the current updated_at premise for subsequent corrections; never bypass disabled cells with a pin.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Typed StateManagementInterface catalog policy lifecycle; no network, deployment, drain or session actions.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: dispatch_authentication_required/dispatch_identity_unregistered: call from a registered session with a derived identity; no role is needed. operator_identity_spoofed: do not supply actor, agent_session_id or agent_instance_id. stale_policy_state/stale_cell_state: read current policy/catalog and decide again with its premise; nothing partially commits. parameter_invalid: correct selector, booleans, weight (a positive finite number, never a boolean or string), action, reason or missing expected_updated_at; supply enabled, weight or both; kind is one nonempty word with no whitespace, words is nonblank and ends_at is an offset-bearing ISO timestamp. rule_not_found: use current rule identifiers. policy_invalid: inspect malformed persisted policy as an integrity error; do not reset silently.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: dispatch_authentication_required/dispatch_identity_unregistered: call from a registered session with a derived identity; no role is needed. operator_identity_spoofed: do not supply actor, agent_session_id or agent_instance_id. stale_policy_state/stale_cell_state: read current policy/catalog and decide again with its premise; nothing partially commits. parameter_invalid: correct selector, booleans, weight (a positive finite number, never a boolean or string), action, reason or missing expected_updated_at; supply enabled, weight or both; kind is one nonempty word with no whitespace, words is nonblank and ends_at is an offset-bearing ISO timestamp. rule_not_found: use current rule identifiers. policy_invalid: inspect malformed persisted policy as an integrity error; do not reset silently.
